skill.summary: Save any product to a universal wishlist. Converts any product URL into a one-click "save for later" link. Works with any retailer, any AI platform, zero setup.

latestVersion.changelog:
add-wish 1.1.0 introduces a universal wishlist feature for saving products from any retailer.

- Instantly saves any product URL to a Wishfinity wishlist via a single link
- Provides clickable "+W Add to Wishlist" links for seamless saving
- Wishfinity automatically extracts and updates product details (title, images, price)
- Works with any online retailer and requires zero setup from developers or users
- Wishlists are shareable and ideal for gifting, tracking, and organizing products for later
- Includes suggestions for when to offer "add to wishlist" options in AI shopping experiences
